{{Quote|He's a very dangerous one, well-known in the Underworld.|Jedi Master Tera Sinube|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
'''Nack Movers''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Movers resided on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After purchasing a [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by his girlfriend [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] and her accomplice [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], who took the weapon.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Let me guess: Nack Movers?|Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano upon finding Movers' corpse|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
Nack Movers was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A skilled [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], Movers was well-known in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Underworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Republic.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TCW" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he bought a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]] and took it to<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" /> [[Nack Movers's residence/Legends|his apartment]]<ref name="NB">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> in a condominium complex.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" /> However, his girlfriend [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]],<ref name="NB" /> together with her accomplice [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Movers and took the weapon. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the owner of the lightsaber, found Movers' dead body and later arrested both Marcy and Cryar.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I got a good price. He was very, very motivated|Bannamu about selling the lightsaber to Movers|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
Movers was a well-known assassin and was eager to buy the lightsaber from Bannamu. He was considered to be a strong, dangerous murderer.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nack Movers first appeared in "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," an episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|the second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, although only as a corpse. The episode aired on [[January 22]], [[2010]]. Movers' design and model were based on that of the Trandoshan [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], a character from the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]].<ref name="Lightsaber Lost Ep Guide" />
